notes.title: Incubus Express July 2022 Updates
notes.content:
[h1][b]Development Updates to Incubus Express![/b][/h1]
Pushing past multiplatform demo releases and what Studio Jigli is up to next

[h3]Hey Everyone~![/h3]
We've been a bit quiet and busy these last few months building up towards larger things! Moving forward we'll be looking to post here more often as things start coming together. On our subscriber platforms we'll be looking to do things slightly differently as well. Thanks for staying up to date with us and looking forward to posting more next month.

[h3]Content Updates[/h3]
Story for the first chapter of Incubus Express is underway and there's been a lot of focus on the story and pacing of quests. Ranks for the characters are getting in now and ways to grow your relationships are getting worked on as well! New shortcut systems exist now too so running back through areas can be made easier if you keep your eyes out for levers and doors.

Some ingredients can only be spotted during the day now and others are only seen at night now so keep your eyes peeled as you hunt. Resources once picked will go away, but just for a little bit, visit back the next day (or night) and it should be ready to gather again!

Serena has her own place now and we're doing the work to integrate the lover's hub associated with that (as well as all the sexy positions and things that come with it)!

[h3]Early Access is now available to certain Subscription tiers on SubscribeStar & Patreon![/h3]
Follow us on Twitter to learn more: [url=https://twitter.com/StudioJigli]https://twitter.com/StudioJigli[/url]
